theorem_title: Physical wanted incidences fit the reporting magnitude
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorWantedConsumerData.incidence_length_le_magnitude
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorPipelineData.Stored μ free n color x A B C hsA hsB hsC) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ThreeSumWantedHostData.config free n A B C hsA hsB hsC).N≤3*(_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.magnitude n)^3 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
If memory stores the full selected-color pipeline for size $n$, original input, and strictly increasing normalized lists $A,B,C$, then the derived wanted configuration has physical incidence count $$N\le3\operatorname{magnitude}(n)^3.$$

This physical count bound supplies finite allocation and word capacity for the actual wanted-incidence array.
